01
Our story

Founded by a trailblazer.

Southern Queens was founded by Faliu Mauu — a trailblazer in the boxing world — and is run as a charitable trust for the people of Southland.

137 Nith St · Invercargill

Boxing is only the beginning. Southern Queens teaches boxing and looks after the whole person — mental, physical, spiritual and emotional wellbeing — with school programmes, South Island champions, and support that goes beyond the gym: help with mental health, driver’s licences and pathways into work.

Most members are Māori and Pasifika rangatahi and whānau. Nobody is turned away for what they can or can’t pay — youth boxing is $5 a class, and free if you can’t pay.
